content_text: Hey, Mr. Deakins. My name is Timothy Owen Weeks and I live in Kuna, Idaho. I’m a Kuna High School Class of 2024 graduate and I have an internship at the Idaho Film Society. After my hay season is complete, I want to start work on a feature film and shoot it on celluloid, but can’t afford new film stocks or cameras and have only an expired film stock and have an old Bell & Howell Super 8 camera. Do you have any advice for me?
